why: Your #1: the pink centre gives the most contrast with her greens (pink sits opposite green on the color wheel). Kelly cane lattice, blush palms and leopards, with enough green to hold the backs.
Looks made for the set: the deep forest ground matches her Forest Green Jade backs, and the pink wildflowers pick up the craks, bams and dots. Lower contrast than Palm Royale, so it's #2.

Oh My Mahjong designed Lotus Cove to go with Juniper, and they're sold together in the starter kit. The pink pond frame and lily pads echo her lotus flower tiles. It has no forest green, so it sits third.
Magenta peonies around a kelly green star: bold, and right on Juniper's pink and green.
Hot pink, chartreuse and kelly: all three of Juniper's loud colors in one mat.
The chartreuse layer's best friend: a lime centre inside a hot pink tropical frame.
Hits every Juniper color: hot pink frame, teal and chartreuse foliage, and a white field like the faces.
Forest green ground full of magenta and pink wildflowers: back, bams and craks in one.
Deep green with cranes and pink blossoms: the garden-at-night mood of the set. Also one of your Malachite picks.
Deep green field inside a pink frame, with a bouquet of pinks and greens.
Forest green with a pink floral medallion. Its olive and orange make it the moodier, Thanksgiving-to-Christmas pick.
Deep green center inside a dark floral border of pinks and lilacs: elegant and dark.
Black ground with pink roses and a green dragon, for the emerald dragon tiles. The darkest pick here.
Deep green-navy night sky with white cranes, coral flowers and a gold moon: a garden after dark, like the set.
Hot pink and kelly green chinoiserie from Oh My Mahjong: the same pink and green, at the same brightness as the faces. Retired.
A chinoiserie garden in pink, mint and lime: the world of the peacock and pagoda tiles.
Hot pink and lime medallion: picks up the chartreuse layer and the pink dots. Sold on Etsy.
Pink, kelly and teal tropical leaves: preppy and bright.
A pagoda garden in pinks and greens under a navy sky, like the pagoda and flower tiles. Sold on Etsy.

mat: Whimsical Chinoiserie Meeting in the Pavilion
why: Pagodas, pink blossoms and green gardens: the flower tiles as a full scene. Sold on Etsy.
Pink roses on big green lily pads around a medallion, close to the lotus flower tiles.
Blush ground, pink roses and a green dragon: the dragon tiles, softened.
White ground like the faces, with roses and a teal dragon: the lightest of the dragon mats.
Soft pink and teal-green toile: the quiet option that lets the faces do the talking.
Bamboo lattice with pink blossoms, like the bam tiles. Its sage green is softer and a little earthier than the backs.
A green stone pattern, like the jade-look stone pattern on her backs. Tone on tone; the faces bring the pink.
Deep green with ferns: tone on tone, like the backs. One of your Malachite picks.
A swirled emerald that looks like the tile backs themselves. Sleek and moody.
The solid pick: the emerald side matches the teal layer, and the celadon side flips it softer.
Your idea to try. Pink camellias with green leaves on a soft pink ground: her pink faces and bamboo greens. No forest green, so it's the light, pretty take. Retired.
Weak, on your list to cut: no forest green and no lime, just a teal-green like her layer and pink blossoms like her faces. Retired.
Weak, on your list to cut: emerald lattice frame with pink peonies and a leopard. It didn't wow you.
